newsitem.title: JAPAN: NEC, Mitsui win Y2.2 bln Paraguay telecom order.
newsitem.headline: NEC, Mitsui win Y2.2 bln Paraguay telecom order.

text.p: NEC Corp said on Wednesday that a consortium formed by it and Mitsui & Co Ltd had won a 2.2 billion yen full turnkey project order involving satellite ground stations in Paraguay.

The order was placed by Paraguay's public telecoms company Administracion Nacional de Telecom (ANTELCO), and the contract will be supported by yen loans from Japan's Overseas Development Agency, NEC said in a statement.

The contract includes the replacement of a ground station previously supplied by NEC and a project involving synchronous digital hierarchy (SDH) fiber-optic communications systems as well as other approach systems, NEC said.

NEC said the project, which is expected to expand the number of international lines in Paraguay from 1,200 to about 4,000, would give it the top share in Paraguay's international communication networks equipment market.
